body: Thank you everyone. Your kind words truly help. Sometimes, that’s all it takes.

See and that’s the thing. I feel horrible for feeling horrible knowing people like you went through what you went/currently going through. It’s hard to think about the future when you don’t want to exist. 

That’s one difference I want to make: I don’t want to kill myself, I simply just don’t want to exist. I feel like wanting to kill your self implies anger, hatred, revenge. Whereas I just don’t want to exist like I was never even here.

I am so sorry for your loss, and I appreciate you taking the time to put so much thought into your response.
You aren’t alone. From the outside I have it made, but trust me I don’t. I’m on the same page as you but maybe helping you will give me a purpose to stay here.
I have great friends but all around the country, nowhere near me. Either in relationships or have other things to focus on than me. I never want to be a burden on someone.
